sheetSync.title: Playgroup sheet
sheetSync.intro: Pulling reads everyone else’s decks. Pushing writes only rows under your name, and only after you tick them.
sheetSync.spreadsheetHint: Paste a full sheet link or its id; the link is stored as an id.
sheetSync.spreadsheetRequired: Required. The sheet must be shared with your service account.
sheetSync.identityCard: Who you are in the sheet
sheetSync.playerHint: Must match column A exactly — rows under this name are the only ones a push writes.
sheetSync.pullNeedsKey: Set the service-account key below first. Viewer access is enough for pulling.
sheetSync.pullHint: Previews changes, then replaces only this device's cached copy of everyone else's decks.
sheetSync.keyConfigured: Key configured locally. The original JSON can be moved or deleted.
sheetSync.keyNeeded: Pushing needs a service-account key with editor access to the sheet.
sheetSync.mappingsHint: Which Scryfall sets each Spanish block label covers. Edit these if the group renames a label or adds a new one.

sheetPush.title: Push my decks
sheetPush.intro: Review the rows that will be written to the shared sheet. Nothing is sent until you select rows and confirm.
sheetPush.matchedHeading: Already in the sheet — optionally remove
sheetPush.matchedHint: These match your decks, so nothing is written. Tick one to take it back out of the sheet — the deck stays in the app.
sheetPush.removeRowTitle: Remove this row from the sheet
sheetPush.unmappedHint: These decks aren’t pushed. Pick the sheet block they belong to, then re-run the preview.
sheetPush.nothingToWrite: Nothing to write — the sheet already matches your decks.

sheetPull.title: Pull others’ decks
sheetPull.intro: Google Sheets is only read here. Applying this preview replaces the cached copy on this device; it never edits the sheet or anyone else’s deck.
sheetPull.labelsRemoved: Set labels gone from sheet — kept, marked as removed
sheetPull.labelsUnmapped: Set labels with no sets — map them under Set mappings
sheetPull.footnote: The local cache, pull timestamp, and set-label mappings update only after you apply.

sheetMappings.emptyHint: Pull the sheet once — these labels come from its EDICIONES tab.
sheetMappings.footnote: Labels come from the sheet's EDICIONES tab plus any label a MAZOS row uses, and refresh on every applied pull. Your edits are kept; unedited labels are re-seeded from the built-in dictionary. Labels gone from the sheet stay listed so their mapping isn't lost.
sheetMappings.mazosOnlyTitle: Used by decks in MAZOS but not listed in the EDICIONES tab
sheetMappings.notInSheetTitle: No longer in the sheet; kept so its mapping is back if the label returns. Not used for pushes.
sheetMappings.noSetsBlocking: No sets mapped — decks from this block cannot be pushed. Add the sets it covers.
sheetMappings.addSetPlaceholder: Add a set — search by name, code or block…

backup.intro: This preview is read-only. Choose whether to merge the JSON into this device or replace the local data represented by the backup.
backup.replaceRemoves: {decks}, {entries}, and {tags} not represented by this JSON.
backup.missingOne: {count} card entry is not in the local card database.
backup.missingOther: {count} card entries are not in the local card database.
backup.footnote: Replace mode only clears decks, collection, tags, and deck filters represented by backup data. Your card database, app settings, and others’ decks stay untouched.
